instruction: In the current project, make two commits: first commit only README.md with message 'add readme', then commit all remaining files with message 'add project files'. Push both to origin main.

command: git config --global user.name "xlang" && git config --global user.email "xlang2024anonym@gmail.com" && mkdir -p /home/user/projects/remote_project && cd /home/user/projects/remote_project && git init --initial-branch=main && git config receive.denyCurrentBranch ignore
unzip -q /home/user/Downloads/binder.zip -d /home/user/projects/ && cd /home/user/projects/binder && git init --initial-branch main && git remote add origin /home/user/projects/remote_project

cd /home/user/projects/remote_project; commit_count=$(git rev-list --count HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$commit_count" -ge 2 ]; then echo "has multiple commits"; fi; first_hash=$(git log --oneline --reverse 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | awk '{print $1}'); second_hash=$(git log --oneline --reverse 2>/dev/null | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $1}'); first_msg=$(git log --format=%s -1 "$first_hash" 2>/dev/null); second_msg=$(git log --format=%s -1 "$second_hash" 2>/dev/null); echo "$first_msg"; echo "$second_msg"; if [ "$first_msg" = "add readme" ] && [ "$second_msg" = "add project files" ]; then echo "correct_commit_order"; fi; first_files=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "$first_hash" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$first_files" = "README.md" ]; then echo "first_commit_only_readme"; fi; second_files=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "$second_hash" 2>/dev/null); second_file_count=$(echo "$second_files" | wc -l); has_readme_in_second=$(echo "$second_files" | grep -c '^README.md$'); if [ "$second_file_count" -ge 1 ] && [ "$has_readme_in_second" -eq 0 ]; then echo "second_commit_has_remaining_files"; fi; cd /home/user/projects/binder; local_id=$(git log --oneline 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | awk '{print $1}'); cd /home/user/projects/remote_project; remote_id=$(git log --oneline 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | awk '{print $1}'); if [ "$local_id" = "$remote_id" ]; then echo "repo is synchronous"; else echo "repo is not synchronous"; fi

[Fixed: added commit content verification and commit order check]
